note: FROZEN before any model comparison. Phase 5 must load this file and must not modify folds, metrics, thresholds, or the label. Scoring is implemented in scripts/hist/eval-protocol.mjs.

label.name: actual_margin
label.leakageRule: never an input to its own game's prediction

market.caveat: market_spread is CFBD's LAST-RECORDED value, NOT a verified closing line. 86% of rows are consensus, only 10.8% DraftKings. Treat as a pre-kickoff line, not a close, and never as identical to BSE's live DraftKings market.

walkForwardRules: Expanding window only. No random splits.
All imputation, scaling, and feature selection are fit on the training fold ONLY, then applied to the test fold.
No feature or hyperparameter may be chosen using the test season being evaluated.
Report every metric per fold, then aggregated. Report twice: including 2020, and excluding/down-weighting 2020.

anomalousSeason2020.treatment: Keep in the archive and identifiable. Report all aggregates BOTH including 2020 and excluding 2020. Recommended default: exclude 2020 from training-fold fitting OR down-weight, and always report fold2 (test=2020) separately as a stress test, never as headline performance.

betSelection.atsCoverRule: HOME covers iff actual_margin > market_implied_home_margin; PUSH iff equal
betSelection.thresholdSelectionRule: A threshold must NOT be chosen on the same season it is evaluated on. Fix thresholds a priori (this list) or select on earlier folds only.

A_independent_fair_line.purpose: BSE's independent opinion of the fair line, comparable to the market without anchoring to it.

B_market_aware_residual.purpose: Detect systematic market mispricing. Prediction = market_implied_home_margin + predicted_residual.
B_market_aware_residual.warning: Because the historical market is 86% consensus (not DraftKings), residual signal learned here may not transfer cleanly to BSE's live DraftKings line. Validate parity before trusting family B live.

modelFamilies.decisionRule: Do NOT assume which family wins. Evaluate both under the identical frozen protocol in Phase 5.

candidateModelSet.name: ridge_linear
candidateModelSet.why: Strong, stable linear baseline; handles the heavy collinearity (prior_sp/prior_fpi r=0.96, form_ppa/scoring r=0.92) via L2 without discarding correlated-but-real signal. Interpretable coefficients.

candidateModelSet.name: elasticnet_linear
candidateModelSet.why: Adds L1 for light feature pruning among redundant families; a defensible sparse linear alternative to ridge.

candidateModelSet.name: gradient_boosted_trees
candidateModelSet.why: Captures mild nonlinearity/interactions (e.g. rest x early-season, talent x form) the audit hints at; robust to feature scale and monotone-ish relationships. Use shallow trees + early stopping on a within-train-fold split.

candidateModelSet.name: market_anchored_ridge (family B)
candidateModelSet.why: Ridge on the residual target; simplest honest test of whether any mispricing signal exists beyond the market.

candidateSetRules: This set is FROZEN. No model shopping: do not expand to dozens of algorithms or sweep large hyperparameter grids searching for something profitable.
Hyperparameters tuned only via nested/earlier-fold validation, never on the evaluated test season.
A candidate beats the market only if it improves MAE AND clears the -110 breakeven ATS rate out-of-sample with temporal stability.

missingDataStrategy.recommendation: Median-impute within the training fold + add an explicit missingness indicator per imputed feature; never impute using test-fold statistics.
missingDataStrategy.seasonOpenerForm: Recent-form features are null by design for a team's first game of the season (~6.7% of sides). Do not fabricate; impute + flag, and consider a 'first_game_of_season' indicator so the model can down-weight form when it is absent.
missingDataStrategy.ratingsCoverage: prior_sp/prior_srs/prior_fpi ~93-98% available (newcomers/reclassifiers lack a prior-season rating). Impute + flag.
missingDataStrategy.elo: 100% available and pregame-clean; the most reliable single power signal.

collinearityWarnings: prior_sp_diff ~ prior_fpi_diff r=0.959 — keep one or regularize.
form_net_ppa_diff ~ form_ppa_overall_diff r=1.00 — duplicates; keep one.
talent_diff ~ recruiting_points_diff r=0.829 — overlapping talent proxy.
elo_diff ~ market_implied_home_margin r=0.912 — for family A do NOT feed the market; elo already carries most of that information.
featureSelectionGuidance.temporalNote: Prior-season ratings & talent are strongest EARLY season; recent-form efficiency is strongest LATE season. A season-progress interaction (or games_played weighting of form) is well-motivated by the early/late split.
